title: Partner Finder: compare Bitcoin partners in 60 seconds | Virtuse
description: Answer a few questions and Partner Finder filters {n} Bitcoin partners to the ones that fit you. You compare and choose. Free, no sign-up.
og_title: Partner Finder: compare Bitcoin partners in 60 seconds
lead: Answer a few questions about your goal, country and how you want to hold your Bitcoin. Partner Finder filters {n} partners to the ones that fit. You compare and choose.
noscript: Partner Finder needs JavaScript. You can also compare partners on the category pages, for example Buy Bitcoin.
counts: {n} partners · {c} categories · {k} EU countries with tailored results
disclosure: Virtuse may earn a referral fee. It doesn't change the results.
s1_p: Buy, borrow, automate, mine, secure or file taxes: pick a goal, your country, how you hold your keys and roughly how much.
s2_p: You see up to three of the {n} partners that match your answers, with their fees and facts side by side.
s3_p: You sign up and complete KYC with the partner. Virtuse never holds your keys, funds or data.
eco_p: Partner Finder only shows these partners. Each one has its own card on virtuse.com.
a1: Yes. It is free and needs no registration. Virtuse may earn a referral fee when you sign up with a partner, at no extra cost to you, and it doesn't change the results.
a2: No. You open an account directly with the partner you choose. Virtuse never holds your keys or funds.
a3: No. Partner Finder filters partners by your criteria. It does not tell you what to buy or which partner to pick.
a4: Only with a link to the official register and the date we checked it. Partners without a sourced licence carry no licence badge.
rel_buy_p: Buy partners and their fees, side by side.
rel_fee_p: Total cost of buying Bitcoin every month.
rel_stack_p: Plan an amount and a rhythm.
rel_data_p: Price, fees and network data, live.
disclaimer: Not investment advice. Virtuse never holds your keys or funds. KYC and onboarding happen on each partner's platform.
